blocking.instructions: Does this log text indicate that the DSH runtime failed to start, or that a required plugin/component did not activate?

criteria.true: Startup stopped, a required component failed, or the run cannot continue
criteria.false: Only a warning, an informational line, or something that still runs

category.instructions: The main cause category of this log text

criteria.peer-version-conflict: A package version does not satisfy the runtime or peer dependency ranges
criteria.missing-credential: A required API key, token or environment variable is absent or invalid
criteria.filesystem-permission: Access denied, locked file, sandbox or ACL problem
criteria.network-registry: Cannot reach a registry, API endpoint or remote host
criteria.runtime-crash: An unhandled error, exception or native crash in the runtime itself
criteria.config-syntax: Invalid configuration, malformed YAML/JSON or a bad patch entry
criteria.other: None of the above is a good description

severity.instructions: How severe is this for the user's ability to keep working
criteria: Blocking: the harness or a required tool cannot start
Data loss, security exposure, or silent wrong results

evidence_sufficient.instructions: Does `log_text` alone contain enough detail to name one concrete cause and one concrete next command? Answer no when the text is vague, truncated, or the cause is genuinely ambiguous.

criteria.true: A specific cause and a specific next command can be named from the text
criteria.false: The text is too vague/truncated to name the cause, or several unrelated causes remain equally likely
